Luguentz Dort scored the Thunder's first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 22 times in 83 starts, or 27% of the games they started. Chet Holmgren was next with 16. The Thunder made the game's first field goal in 51% of their 96 games and won 48% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
